record.title: R58 independent consumer fanout learning
record.body: Durable learning: once a canonical adapter-capital primitive is default-contained, the multiplier is realized by target-local identity/authority/receipt boundaries in genuinely distinct consumer domains, not by adding more producer courts. Consumer adapters should execute the same producer-owned contract while isolating their verifier from unrelated repository test configuration. A scoped consumer court may be ALIVE while the repository owner rail remains REQUALIFYING; merge and producer-census assimilation must wait for the owner rail.

metadata.novel_falsifier: global pytest configuration can create false-negative consumer qualification after all semantic courts pass
metadata.repair_rule: bound reusable verifier execution to explicit verifier configuration without weakening application owner rails
